items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I called up Memphis and told her to come to Boston. I sent her the $75 to catch a train to Boston.

ctx.x: So we went and played all the way across the country, and we was in Washington -- I got in a blackjack game and I won $75. So I called up Memphis and told her to come to Boston. I sent her the $75 to catch a train to Boston.
